{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Midi skirt in slate blue, A-line silhouette, mid-calf length, wool blend with a subtle herringbone weave.
Fitted blouse in crisp white, relaxed fit through the waist but structured at the button placket, long sleeves, pearl-white cotton poplin.
Blazer in charcoal grey, cropped length hitting just above the hip to elongate the leg line, single-breasted, heavy-weight wool with a soft shoulder.
Loafers in tan leather, cap-toe design, flat sole for all-day comfort.

This outfit works perfectly for an autumn office day while strictly honoring the wish to keep the belly quiet; the cropped blazer creates vertical lines that draw the eye upward toward the face and away from the midsection. The A-line midi skirt flows gently over the torso without clinging, further minimizing attention on the goal zone while remaining professional enough for a business environment. By keeping the top layer structured and the bottom loose, the ensemble balances polish with comfort, ensuring you feel confident and polished throughout your workday."}
